organizations.name: Lambda Chi Alpha - Gamma-Iota Zeta
organizations.position: High Rho - Alumni Development Officer · Jan 2020 - Present
organizations.description: As High Rho, I serve as the liaison between the undergraduate chapter and alumni brothers of Lambda Chi Alpha's Gamma Iota Zeta at Denison University. My responsibilities include maintaining alumni records, publishing a newsletter, organizing alumni events, and overall alumni engagement and stewardship. I work to foster lifelong brotherhood by keeping alumni informed and involved with the chapter. Key duties include coordinating the chapter's Lamplighter newsletter, maintaining the alumni directory, planning annual Alumni Weekend and Alumni Formal events, and developing other initiatives to strengthen alumni participation. The role allows me to utilize my organizational and communication skills while advancing the fraternal bond between current undergraduates and alumni members.
